# LOOP C model file: Asia MF1 (Lb0e6dfa3_R0_F40_80), 13-week refit bundle, loss mode theta 0.2 (W-DYNML)

Version hash (sha256 of the gz below): `94722185cf6dcd4cb6469ab02807f93714efc0c5d790cfb7a85501026a285bde`. Built 2026-11-27 15:13 UTC. Research only; quick-screen result for these exact models: DD 18.6k -> 7.1k, income 62.9k -> 226.8k vs own 40/80, 12/12 forward periods shallower (weeks 52-181); NOT yet an exact-engine verdict.

## What the file holds
A gzip of one JSON: `{tag, step:13, params, periods:[{wk0,wk1,t0,t1,fit_end,n_fit_rows,n_fit_signals,models:[4 x LightGBM model_to_string text],sha256:[4 x sha256 of each text]}], max_abs_diff_vs_bundle}`. Decode: `base64 -d | gunzip > lgbtext.json`. Same models as the compiled-tree bundle on box1 (`loopc_Lb0e6dfa3_R0_F40_80_s13.json.gz`; the text dump was re-fitted from the same data with the same seeds and reproduces the compiled trees with max abs prediction diff 0.0 on 100 rows per period and model). Raw file: box1 `/mnt/l2/l2vast/_dynexit/loopc/lgbtext_Lb0e6dfa3_R0_F40_80_s13.json.gz`.

Model order inside a period: index 0 = TAKE-ALL, 1 = TIGHTEN, 2 = PART, 3 = TRAIL. Each is a LightGBM regression (objective regression L2); the prediction is the model's raw output = the sum of the leaf values of its trees (the init/average score is folded into the first tree by LightGBM, so init = 0); output unit = predicted advantage over holding, in R0 (R0 = the book's OWN stop distance in points; the hook's safety stop is 1.5 x R0).

## Params (all models)
`{"n_estimators": 60, "learning_rate": 0.1, "num_leaves": 15, "min_child_samples": 300, "subsample": 0.7, "subsample_freq": 1, "colsample_bytree": 0.7, "reg_lambda": 10.0, "max_bin": 63, "n_jobs": 1, "verbose": -1}` (60 trees, 15 leaves, 63 bins, 1 thread, seeds LightGBM defaults, row subsample 0.7 every iteration, feature fraction 0.7). Target = clip(advantage in R0, -3, 3). Trees per model 60.

## FEATURE ORDER (final hook list, 18 features, in this order; HAR, ATR, prior-session efficiency and time-to-session-end were DROPPED)
0. `openR`
1. `mfeR`
2. `maeR`
3. `sec`
4. `R0pts`
5. `hod`
6. `nq60`
7. `nq300`
8. `nq900`
9. `ES60`
10. `ES300`
11. `RTY60`
12. `RTY300`
13. `CL60`
14. `CL300`
15. `ZN60`
16. `ZN300`
17. `gap`

Definitions (side = +1 long, -1 short; R0 = risk0 / 1.5, risk0 = safety stop distance in points): openR = open P&L / R0; mfeR = best open P&L so far / R0; maeR = worst open P&L so far (negative number) / R0; sec = seconds since fill; R0pts = R0 in points; hod = ET hour of the ENTRY second minus 18 h (Globex-day hour, hours + minutes/60; fixed for the trade); nq60/300/900 = side x (NQ close now - NQ close N s ago) / R0 (feed NQ, 1-s closes, lag 1 s); ES60 ES300 RTY60 RTY300 CL60 CL300 ZN60 ZN300 = side x 1e4 x (close now / close N s ago - 1) in bp (instr_1s closes, lag 1 s; NaN if the series has a gap > 5 s); gap = ES300 - (NQ 300 s return in bp), both side-signed. NaN is allowed and handled by the trees (default direction learned by LightGBM).

## Training window and purge
Each period model was fitted only on states of trades whose path (safety-stop replay to session end) ended at least 24 h before `fit_end` (= forward period start - 1 day), last 104 weeks of signals, subsampled to at most 150,000 state rows; states every 60 s of trade time.
